description: Agent 4 produces deterministic GO/HOLD on APCS bundle.
Agent 5 raises HOLD on unresolved Phase 5 hard gate.
Brain blocks Phase 5 when Phase 4 is HOLD without override.
CI pipeline runs Agent 4 on push and PR, Agent 5 on push/release.
Promotion to TEST and PROD gated by GitHub environments.
Pipeline publishes Agent 4 and Agent 5 reports as artifacts.
Pipeline publishes the build/test stage results artifact.
CI bridge degrades gracefully when not configured.
Artifact downloads strip Authorization on cross-host redirect.
Dashboard exposes a CI / CD Pipeline tab with reports.
Dashboard supports approving or rejecting pending deployments.
Dashboard auto-refreshes while runs are non-terminal.
Evidence references include relative path and snippet.
Container images deployed to TEST/PROD pinned by digest.
Helm chart mounts api_key and ci_bridge_token from Secret.
Image build, push and GitOps update done by the pipeline.
Each requirement linked to at least one test case.
No open critical defect and no blocker email for TEST.
